features.name: Compact revolver using relatively light ammunition and limited capacity.
Use own ASP rounded compact barrel/cylinder housing, short curved grip and trigger-guard outline; do not substitute neighboring VZ/120 semi-automatic body.

Assigned sole final reference reviewer inspected original detail/new clay, native mattes, final2048 detail and clay teal previews, clay mask and paired overlay using retained accepted primary-source facts. Colt Asp compact rounded upper, sloping lower-front frame, muzzle cavity, gross cylinder/flutes and backed junctions, rear hammer contour, grip/finger profile, raised smooth controls and complete trigger/guard clearance retained. Broad cylinder/frame recesses and the front backed control pocket are major construction; fine screw slots, texture and shallow microchannels are filled. Clay RGB unchanged from actual generator output. Independent alpha masks retain true thin members and one connected guard opening; only explicitly identified one-pixel guard-edge AA fringe labels discarded, no subject parts. No mask transfer/shape warp. Common uniform crop and resampling, native1254square RGB opaque→2048 honestly declared. Reference-only approval; no geometry/native/client/production approval.
